Redfern Group Names New Chief Operating Officer to Drive UK Expansion

Redfern Group, a leading player in the UK’s engineering and construction sector, announced the appointment of Sarah McKenna as its new Chief Operating Officer, effective immediately. McKenna steps into the role amid a period of robust growth for the company as it seeks to capitalise on the government’s £12 billion National Infrastructure Strategy and a surge in demand for sustainable construction solutions.

McKenna, previously Managing Director at Millgate Engineering, brings over 20 years of industry experience and a track record of overseeing major public and private sector projects across the UK and Ireland. Her appointment comes as Redfern Group moves to strengthen its executive team and sharpen its focus on operational efficiency.

“We are delighted to welcome Sarah at a time of significant opportunity for Redfern,” said Jonathan Miles, CEO of Redfern Group, in a statement on Tuesday. “Her leadership and deep sector expertise will be invaluable as we expand our project portfolio and invest in new technologies.”

Analysts see the move as a signal of Redfern’s intention to scale up its participation in large-scale infrastructure developments, including transport, energy, and public sector projects. “Redfern’s decision to bring in a COO with Sarah’s credentials suggests a strong commitment to operational excellence and delivery,” commented Amira Patel, construction sector analyst at Wayforth Advisory. “It reflects the broader trend in the industry towards professionalisation and sustainable growth.”

The appointment has also been welcomed by the Civil Engineering Contractors Association, with spokesperson Tom Naylor noting, “Leadership appointments like this are essential for maintaining momentum in the UK’s construction pipeline.” Redfern Group currently employs over 2,300 people across its UK operations.
